name: tyk-skills
description: Evaluate and use Tyk with an AI coding agent: verified facts, Tyk OAS API definitions, rate limits and policies, GitOps delivery, MCP and AI gateways, Developer Portal branding, a working proof of concept, architecture diagrams, infrastructure sizing, production deployment and migration planning.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate Tyk with an AI coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Check any Tyk fact against the public documentation and a running stack; write Tyk OAS API definitions that load and behave as intended; give each consumer its own rate limit and quota; deliver configuration through CI with Tyk Sync, Tyk Operator or plain files; put MCP servers behind Tyk Gateway and turn REST APIs into MCP tools; run Tyk AI Studio as an AI gateway; brand the Developer Portal end to end; build and verify a Docker Compose proof of concept; draw the deployment; size the infrastructure; plan, run and audit a production install from the public tyk-install repository; and map a Kong, Apigee or other gateway estate onto Tyk.
defaultPrompt: Is Tyk Gateway open source, and which parts need a licence?
Give partner A 100 requests a second and partner B 10 on the same Tyk API, and prove it.
Expose our Orders OpenAPI as MCP tools through Tyk Gateway with OAuth.
We run Kong today. Map our plugins and workflow onto Tyk.
